reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin for browsing conversation branches and editing eligible historical user messages while preserving append-only session history.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供会话分支浏览和符合条件的历史用户消息编辑功能。
summaries.en: Adds conversation branch browsing and eligible historical user-message editing to the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Adds inline editing controls for completed plain-text user messages
Displays conversation history as navigable branches
Creates an edited user turn and requests a regenerated assistant response
Appends conversation replacement metadata without deleting historical events
